<props="china">Specifies whether to retain attribute settings during the reset. If this parameter is not specified, attribute configurations are not retained by default. This parameter takes effect only for cloud phone matrix instances. Run the wya dump config command to view the details of retained attributes.</props>
<props="intl">This parameter is not supported on the international site.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">重置是否保留属性设置，不传则默认不保留属性配置，该参数仅针对云手机矩阵实例生效。可执行wya dump config命令查看保留的属性详情。</props>
<props="intl">国际站不支持此参数</props>
